name: Hit and Run
flavor: You run the length of the fight with the knife out, opening every foe you pass, and somewhere along the way an arrow leaves your bow.

body.label: Effect
body.text: You Advance. Before the first square and after each square of this Advance, each enemy adjacent to you becomes a target of your [[Light (property)|Light]] weapon, once each. Once, at any point of the Advance, one creature within your bow's Range becomes a target of your bow; it can be a target of the Light weapon too. You draw and stow the two weapons freely during this Action.

body.label: Special
body.text: The bow's hit is Doomed if you are Engaged when you make it.

body.label: Attack
body.text: Weapon vs. Armor Defense. Roll 3d12 once, when the first creature is hit: every hit of this Action uses those dice, each worked out on its own as for [[Several Targets]] (the first two dice, unless that hit is Favored or Doomed).

target: Each enemy adjacent to you at any point of the Advance, and one creature within your bow's Range

foundry.automationNote: the Advance (the button) and one roll (Use it against the first creature); each other hit worked out by hand from the same 3d12 (the first two dice, unless that hit is Favored or Doomed), as for Several Targets; the targets before the first square, the free draws and the bow shot by hand.
